Subject: Holtec Key Leadership Changes

Dear Sir or Madam:

Please be advised of several key leadership changes within Holtec International and
Holtec Decommissioning International, effective October 19, 2026.

As part of these changes, Matthew Johnson has assumed the position of Site Vice
President of Indian Point Energy Center (IPEC), where he will provide leadership and
oversight of site operations and activities in support of the facility’s ongoing
decommissioning.

Additionally, Dr. Kris Singh, Chief Executive Officer of Holtec International, will assume
the additional role of President of Holtec International, succeeding Dr. Rick Springman

in that capacity. This transition represents an important change in the company’s
executive leadership structure, with Dr. Singh serving in both leadership roles.

These leadership changes reflect the continued evolution of the management structure
across Holtec International and Holtec Decommissioning International’s Indian Point
Energy Center facility.

We appreciate your attention to these appointments and ask that you update your
records accordingly, as appropriate.

Mr. Johnson can be reached at m.johnson1@holtec.com. Should you have any
questions or require additional information, please contact me at (856) 797-0900 x
3587.
